exception.thread_id_evidence_note: CDB's stored exception context selects OS thread 0xD9F4. The crash reporter text names 0xD1BC; the all-thread dump shows 0xD1BC in NtGetContextThread. The discrepancy is retained rather than normalized away.

log_sequence: omni.rtx semaphore-release fatal at about 4.95 s after shutdown_complete
omni.rtx GPU crash dump write begins immediately afterward
breakpad reports termination and writes the minidump
stored int 3 exception occurs about 6.19 s after shutdown_complete
shutdown_timing.bounded_inference: The CPU and Private Bytes rise aligns with RTX teardown failure plus GPU/minidump capture and crash-report generation. It is not evidence that Stage, Flow, or A/B/C operations ran. Exact allocation ownership is unavailable in the user minidump.

phase6io.stack_family: crash reporter breakpoint after terminate/abort; unwind reaches omni.usd audio/context tasking; log also records RTX teardown failure

phase6ik_comparison.reason: Both occur only after shutdown_complete and involve omni.usd/context teardown, but the recorded exception modules, instructions, and immediate mechanisms differ. Phase 6IO additionally has an RTX semaphore/GPU-crash sequence not established for Phase 6IK.

limitations: The source is a user minidump, not a full-memory dump.
Only local build and OS module paths were used; no network symbols were requested.
ntdll symbols did not match, so WinDbg !analyze produced a wrong-symbol bucket; the explicit exception context and stack remained readable.
omni.usd has export symbols only, so several private frames are represented by their nearest exported symbol.
The dump localizes the stored breakpoint and unwind but does not prove the original C++ exception type or exact resource owner.

After the read-only audit completed, repo.bat build invoked three Kit extension-precache processes. They did not open Phase 6IO, Stage, Layer, or Flow evidence, but this violated the Phase-wide no-Kit-launch constraint and is retained as a contract deviation.

decision.recommended_next_boundary: With separate approval, run a bounded small Stage-free post-shutdown re-observation population using the unchanged monitor and preserve full evidence only for the first anomaly signature. Do not start A/B/C until its lifecycle gate is explicitly decided.
